charts.title: TOI-178 c: orbits around TOI-178
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-178's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-178 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Leleu et al. 2021 (2021A&A...649A..26L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LELEU_ET_AL__2021): P 3.23845 d

charts.title: TOI-178 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-178 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (29, 69, 106) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 251848941, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 16 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 41 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 8-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 16 min early; 8-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 14 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
